name: safe-net
description: Safe-Net — cybersecurity LMS, phishing simulator, and the SafeNet Guard browser extension

scripts.dev: bun run db:up && concurrently -n api,web,ml -c cyan,magenta,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "bun:dev:api" "bun:dev:web" "bun:dev:ml"
scripts.dev:no-ml: bun run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "bun:dev:api" "bun:dev:web"
scripts.dev:ml: cd ml-service && { [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || { echo '[ml] no .venv — run \"bun run setup:ml\", or use \"bun run dev:no-ml\"'; exit 0; }; } && exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && cd server && bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: bun run install:all && bun run db:up && cd server && bunx prisma generate && bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma db seed
scripts.setup:ml: cd ml-service && python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: bun install && cd server && bun install && cd ../client && bun install && cd ../extension && bun install
scripts.test:ml: cd ml-service && [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && .venv/bin/python scripts/test_scoring.py || echo '[ml] skipped — run bun run setup:ml'
